storage: recursive carrier arrays and data records with native ARC fields
shared __block carriers and data records using native forwarding cells
contract.calls: Objective-C messages and Blocks admit qualified data records using the same fresh indirect result and callee-owned argument snapshot convention as C and C++. Nil receivers zero results and release snapshots.
contract.initialization: Own completed ivars before initializer temporary cleanup. Failure destroys completed ivars in reverse order, then completed superclass state, and frees the allocation. Checked instance allocation rejects arithmetic overflow.
contract.identity: ABI 11 nominal carrier encodings and helper identities; semantic interfaces preserve native ivar ownership, access, array declarators, and effective property attributes. Template property matches rebind arm declarations through native instantiation scopes.
contract.release: Independent installed suites run concurrently within host CPU and memory limits, join every gate, and retain separate evidence. Failed processes or incomplete receipts prevent publication.
boundaries: unions, packed or volatile runtime storage
runtime records with non-data C++ special members or bases
public Optional/Result and synchronous throws syntax remain reserved
